headline: Indian markets rebound as Sensex gains 315 points following Thursday's sharp 1,200-point sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Value buying in key sectors after Thursday's 1,200-point Sensex crash
Government reduction of the FY27 market borrowing target to Rs 7.86 lakh crore
Strong performance in the auto and consumer durables sectors
Global AI enthusiasm helping to offset concerns over rising oil prices and bond yields
whatHappening: The BSE Sensex ended the day over 300 points higher, closing near the 23,150 mark
The NSE Nifty50 recovered to trade above 23,000 after falling below it on Thursday
Tamil Nadu government announced plans to develop fintech Global Capability Centres in Chennai and Coimbatore
The Sensex has lost approximately 3,300 points since the announcement of India's blockbuster GDP figures
summary: Indian markets staged a recovery on Friday, with the Sensex gaining 315 points as investors engaged in value buying across key sectors. The rebound follows a significant crash on Thursday, supported by the government's decision to lower its market borrowing target. While auto and consumer durables sectors gained, the IT sector remained under pressure amid global volatility.
